falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; breaking below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the bottoming pattern and confirm continuation lower, not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled volatility/early recovery phase; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling and regime change to crisis mode, contradicting the bottom signal

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts more than -50 basis points (i.e., -50bps or wider)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion beyond August 2024 extremes would signal worsening economic conditions and Fed policy error, invalidating the macro bottom thesis that assumed stabilization

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
